invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of execute(), which should not be null to adhere to typical API contracts.
The getWriteStatuses method should return a non-null List as part of write metadata.
A List's size is always non-negative if not null.
bulkInsertPartitioner is an Option type and should not be null by convention; it may represent an empty option but the object itself should not be null.
instantTime is typically a non-null, non-empty string corresponding to the commit/instant.
